text:
Delivers: The reports page downloads on-demand CSV exports with every table column and bounded paging. The PR covers AC1-2 and AC4 of acme/widgets#45; AC4's observable half (completion under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so a paging fix would need to be made twice. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Blockers:
1. Exports are not emailed to the requesting user, so the promised delivery path is missing. The ticket contains no explicit split permitting this work to move to a follow-up. (src/api/export.ts, acme/widgets#45)
2. Export events are not recorded in the audit log, so the promised audit trail is missing. Deferring this work in the PR and spec does not waive the requirement because the ticket contains no corresponding split. (src/api/export.ts, doc/specs/2026-09-30-csv-export.md, acme/widgets#45)

Verdict: fixable - 2 blockers

1. review - post both blockers as a comment on your PR [recommended]
2. show evidence - show the gate evidence, AC outcomes, and drafted payloads
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility is available).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The report has a clear Delivers line, verdict and numbered menu, but it gives the wrong reason for row 3 (it blames a missing ticket split rather than a deferral naming no ticket, spec path or URL), wrongly mints a second blocker for row 5 despite the spec deferring it to acme/widgets#46, and places nits ahead of the blockers.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The actionable first-screen briefing misstates row 3's gap and incorrectly blocks row 5, yielding two blockers, but offers no merge and shows no post without a pick.
